disposition_reason: DIMM identifiers can be parameterized only after vendor rail/voltage encodings and platform PMIC/I2C ownership are defined. ED-03/12/15/16 and project I2C ownership rules require Pending/BLOCKED until an authoritative electrical matrix exists.

test_case.test_name: DDR5 PMIC SWA fatal per-DIMM/voltage matrix
test_case.purpose: For every approved DIMM and SWA voltage type, inject one authoritative PMIC fatal fault, verify reset and fresh rail-specific evidence, then restore electrical, I2C and memory health before another tuple.
required_package: Approved command continuation and per-target tuples
Electrical/thermal limits, durable evidence, OOB memory recovery and rollback
test_case.test_command: Do not join or execute the source command. After approval, map one physical PMIC target, capture rail/thermal/SPD/I2C/memory baseline, run one exact vendor tuple once under OOB capture, correlate SWA status and reset, then restore PMIC/I2C settings and prove DIMM training/workload health before another voltage or DIMM.
test_case.expected_result: Each authorized tuple produces the signed SWA fatal event/reset and fresh source record while remaining within approved transient limits; all DIMMs retrain/enumerate, bounded memory succeeds, telemetry/I2C recover and settings equal baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until rail/voltage/target/syntax and electrical limits are authoritative. Tool PASS, generic PMIC logs, guessed address/tuple, out-of-envelope rail/temperature, missing DIMM, boot/training failure or incomplete restoration fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated instrumented DDR5 SUT with independent OOB and approved PMIC recovery.
One DIMM/voltage tuple once; no batch loop.
Abort immediately on mapping mismatch, unsafe voltage/current/temperature, reset anomaly, I2C loss or DIMM disappearance.
expected_evidence: DIMM/PMIC/I2C/rail tuple matrix and vendor encoding authority
Per-tuple command and OOB reset/boot timeline
In-envelope recovery, DIMM training/workload and restoration
test_case.recovery: Restore PMIC mode/fault recovery, SPD host control, telemetry, I2C enables, BIOS/HDT and memory training; cover boot failure or lost DIMM through approved OOB/reimage/hardware recovery. Execution remains blocked until approved.

blocked.reason: An ambiguous PMIC rail fault can damage memory power, prevent boot or remove DIMMs without authoritative electrical recovery.
